title: Assistant chain: one global assistant, fast per sentence, the mastermind gets the refined prompt

chat.text: A Sonnet task mastermind maps what happens to one transcribed sentence today, hop by hop with timings, then builds the slice you described behind a flag: one global assistant per owner (not one per page), a fast reply on screen per sentence, a smart pass at each batch boundary that only suggests, and the refined prompt handed to the mastermind once per batch. Proven headless with a three-sentence dictation.
